instruction: Scale the entire image to 50% of its current size.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully resized the dog layer to 512px height by selecting the dog layer, opening Layer > Scale Layer dialog, setting height to 512 (auto-calculated width to 852), and applying the scale.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can select specific layers in GIMP, navigate Layer menu, use Scale Layer dialog, set dimensions with aspect ratio lock, apply transformations.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests a related but different operation: scaling the entire image (Image > Scale Image) rather than just a single layer. Requires knowledge of the difference between layer and image scaling.
metadata.explanation: Task requires scaling the whole image (both layers) to 50% size. Original is 1578x948, so target is 789x474. Evaluator exports and checks full image dimensions (no ignore_transparent since entire image is scaled). Partial credit: 0.5 for correct width, 0.5 for correct height.
